tha-ap147:1.1: lokamahite āhutīnaṁ → lokanāthambhi ahutīnaṁ (bj) | lokanāthambhi → lokamhite (bj: machasaṁ) | lokamahite → lokanāthamhi (cck: sī.)
tha-ap147:2.3: umāpupphaṁ → ummāpupphaṁ (bj, sya-all) | Umāpupphaṁ → ummāpupphaṁ (cck: sabbattha)
tha-ap147:3.4: thūpapūjāyidaṁ → pupphapūjāyidaṁ (sya-all) | thūpapūjāyidaṁ → pupphapūjāyidaṁ (cck: syā.); buddhapūjāyidaṁ (cck: ka.)
